title: Pan-Seared Brussels Sprouts with Garlic Delight
description: A simple yet flavorful recipe featuring pan-seared Brussels sprouts topped with a garlic delight. This dish is perfect as a side or main course.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Brussels sprouts to the skillet, cut side down.
Cook for 4-5 minutes or until they develop a nice brown crust.
Flip the Brussels sprouts and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes or until tender.
In a small bowl, mix together the kneaded bread crumbs and garlic delight.
Sprinkle the bread crumb mixture over the Brussels sprouts and cook for 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
